kaer_morhen_steel_sword.name: Kaer Morhen Steel Sword
kaer_morhen_steel_sword.description: A well-tempered steel blade from Kaer Morhen. Good vs humans and beasts.

steel_sword_basic.name: Basic Steel Sword
steel_sword_basic.description: An ordinary steel sword. Reliable and cheap.

novigrad_longsword.name: Novigradian Longsword
novigrad_longsword.description: Standard issue for temple guards. Heavy, but deals a solid blow.

gwyhyr.name: Mahakaman Gwyhyr
gwyhyr.description: Forged by dwarven smiths in Mahakam. Razor-sharp and incredibly light.

kaer_morhen_silver_sword.name: Kaer Morhen Silver Sword
kaer_morhen_silver_sword.description: Forged to fight monsters — silver cuts through many unnatural defenses.

silver_sword_basic.name: Basic Silver Sword
silver_sword_basic.description: A simple silver blade — effective against many monsters.

griffin_silver_sword.name: Griffin Silver Sword
griffin_silver_sword.description: A beautifully balanced silver sword carrying the sigil of the Griffin School.

aerondight.name: Aerondight
aerondight.description: A legendary blade bestowed by the Lady of the Lake. Its edge never dulls.

kaer_morhen_armor.name: Kaer Morhen Armor
kaer_morhen_armor.description: Sturdy armor issued at Kaer Morhen. Excellent protection without too much weight.

kaer_morhen_boots.name: Kaer Morhen Boots
kaer_morhen_boots.description: Boots worn by witchers — comfortable and protective.

viper_basic_armor.name: Viper Basic Armor
viper_basic_armor.description: Sturdy leather armor reinforced with metal plates, favored by witchers of the Viper School.

viper_basic_gauntlets.name: Viper Basic Gauntlets
viper_basic_gauntlets.description: Simple but durable gloves that improve grip and slightly boost protection.

viper_basic_trousers.name: Viper Basic Trousers
viper_basic_trousers.description: Lightweight trousers that allow for flexibility in combat without sacrificing too much protection.

viper_basic_boots.name: Viper Basic Boots
viper_basic_boots.description: Witcher-grade boots designed for long treks and swift movement.

griffin_armor.name: Griffin Armor
griffin_armor.description: Medium armor clad in brass plates. Boosts the intensity of Witcher Signs.

griffin_gauntlets.name: Griffin Gauntlets
griffin_gauntlets.description: Thick leather and brass gauntlets designed for weaving signs quickly.

ursine_heavy_armor.name: Ursine Heavy Armor
ursine_heavy_armor.description: Heavy chainmail and thick leather favored by the Bear School. Excellent defense.

ursine_trousers.name: Ursine Trousers
ursine_trousers.description: Reinforced trousers that can withstand glancing blows from monster claws.

hunters_armor.name: Hunter's Armor
hunters_armor.description: Standard padded armor worn by professional trackers and hunters in Velen.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.description: A basic witcher potion that accelerates vitality regeneration. Use in combat to quickly recover health.

swallow_strong.name: Strong Swallow
swallow_strong.description: A reinforced Swallow with a stronger healing effect. Restores a larger amount of vitality over a short period.

swallow_superior.name: Superior Swallow
swallow_superior.description: The most potent Swallow variant available to witchers. Rapidly restores a large amount of vitality.

hybrid_oil.name: Hybrid Oil
hybrid_oil.description: Applied to silver swords — increases damage against hybrid monsters.

necrophage_oil.name: Necrophage Oil
necrophage_oil.description: Increases silver sword effectiveness against necrophages.

specter_oil.name: Specter Oil
specter_oil.description: Helpful against specters and wraiths when applied to silver blades.

relict_oil.name: Relict Oil
relict_oil.description: Powerful oil used against ancient and relict creatures.

monster_bone.name: Monster Bone
monster_bone.description: A sturdy bone harvested from a slain beast. Useful for basic crafting.

celandine.name: Celandine
celandine.description: A common yellow flower found in fields and forests. Essential for brewing the Swallow healing potion.

white_myrtle.name: White Myrtle
white_myrtle.description: A very common white flower found in field and forests, very essential for brewing Witcher Potions.

dwarven_spirit.name: Dwarven Spirit
dwarven_spirit.description: A remarkably strong, harsh dwarven liquor. Used as a base for brewing potions and replenishing alchemy supplies.

monster_blood.name: Monster Blood
monster_blood.description: Thick, dark blood. A staple ingredient in many witcher alchemy recipes.

monster_essence.name: Monster Essence
monster_essence.description: Concentrated magical essence dropped by powerful creatures and specters.

monster_saliva.name: Monster Saliva
monster_saliva.description: Foul-smelling fluid collected from necrophages and hybrids. Toxic but useful.

hide.name: Animal Hide
hide.description: Cured skin from a beast. Can be dismantled into leather scraps.

lesser_runestone.name: Lesser Runestone
lesser_runestone.description: A weakly glowing stone that can be socketed into witcher gear to enhance combat abilities.

metal_scrap.name: Metal Scrap
metal_scrap.description: Metal scrap used in crafting various witcher gear.

leather_scrap.name: Leather Scrap
leather_scrap.description: Used in crafting witcher wearables gears.

griffin_feathers.name: Griffin Feathers
griffin_feathers.description: Stiff feathers harvested from a griffin. Essential for hybrid oils and mastercrafted gear.

drowner_brain.name: Drowner Brain
drowner_brain.description: A spongy, foul-smelling brain. Crucial for brewing Swallow potions.

siren_vocal_cords.name: Siren Vocal Cords
siren_vocal_cords.description: The delicate vocal cords of a siren. Used in crafting hybrid oils and high-tier swords.

specter_dust.name: Specter Dust
specter_dust.description: Remains of a wraith. Needed to bind specter oils.

leshen_resin.name: Leshen Resin
leshen_resin.description: Hardened sap from a defeated leshen. Used in top-tier relict oils.

wyvern_egg.name: Wyvern Egg
wyvern_egg.description: A large, speckled egg harvested from a wyvern. Essential for draconid oils.

nekker_claw.name: Nekker Claw
nekker_claw.description: A sharp, curved claw from a nekker. Used in basic ogroid and necrophage alchemy.

foglet_teeth.name: Foglet Teeth
foglet_teeth.description: Translucent, razor-sharp teeth used in advanced necrophage alchemy.

ghoul_blood.name: Ghoul's Blood
ghoul_blood.description: Thick, coagulated blood from a ghoul. A common base ingredient for necrophage oils.

werewolf_saliva.name: Werewolf Saliva
werewolf_saliva.description: Highly concentrated and toxic saliva. Prized for brewing cursed oils.

elemental_essence.name: Elemental Essence
elemental_essence.description: A dense chunk of magical essence dropped by golems and elementals. Used to sharpen blades and brew oils.

fiend_eye.name: Fiend's Eye
fiend_eye.description: The massive, hypnotic third eye of a fiend. Used for the strongest relict oils.

water_hag_tooth.name: Water Hag Tooth
water_hag_tooth.description: A rotten, jagged tooth from a water hag. Used to brew necrophage oils and decoctions.

harpy_feathers.name: Harpy Feathers
harpy_feathers.description: Stiff feathers used in hybrid oils.

alghoul_bone_marrow.name: Alghoul Bone Marrow
alghoul_bone_marrow.description: Extracted from the spiked bones of an alghoul. Highly sought after by alchemists.

dog_tallow.name: Dog Tallow
dog_tallow.description: Dog tallow is an alchemy ingredient in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt that is needed to craft many blade oils

bear_fat.name: Bear Fat
bear_fat.description: Bear fat is an alchemy ingredient that is needed to craft many blade oils.

arenaria.name: Arenaria
arenaria.description: A white-flower used in crafting various Witcher Oils.

ergot_seeds.name: Ergot Seeds
ergot_seeds.description: A resources used in cooking various Witcher Oils/Gears.

mistletoe.name: Mistletoe
mistletoe.description: A resources used in cooking various Witcher Oils/Gears.

puffball.name: Puffball
puffball.description: A resources used in cooking various Witcher Oils/Gears.

raw_meat.name: Raw Meat
raw_meat.description: Tough, raw meat. Restores a small amount of vitality, but it's better if roasted.

water.name: Water
water.description: A simple flask of spring water. Refreshes the body slightly.

bread.name: Loaf of Bread
bread.description: Stale but filling. A standard ration for travelers.
